scope_statement: Only the candidate-added allow_remote_refs gate residual named by this GHSA: file:// is exempt from --no-allow-remote-refs, and the later closer applies that same flag to file:// plus local-path confinement.

gate_rationale.identity_gate: Frozen github-reviewed GHSA-8359-h9fx-j6v9 is unwithdrawn, aliases CVE-2026-55389, names koxudaxi/datamodel-code-generator and the file:// / --no-allow-remote-refs bypass.
gate_rationale.ai_hunk_gate: Parent has no allow_remote_refs. Candidate first-parent adds the HTTP gate and the exact if not resolved_ref.startswith("file://") skip quoted by the GHSA. Every reconstructed squash member carries a Claude Opus 4.6 trailer. No second human member.
gate_rationale.topology_gate: Single parent 7e1a5c75. GitHub squash of PR 3051. Author Mikhail Butvin. Only AI coauthor is Claude. This is not Copilot-trailer transfer onto a different human member hunk.
gate_rationale.but_for_gate: Patch-delta: the AI change is an explicit remote-ref security attempt that omitted file://. GHSA names that residual. Closer 2ff4a72 removes the exemption and routes local refs through the same allow_remote_refs flag. Reopening the older ungated filesystem read is not a patch-delta failure.
gate_rationale.fix_reversal_gate: 2ff4a72 amends _get_ref_body so --no-allow-remote-refs applies to file:// and adds _resolve_local_ref_path. Tag 0.62.0 contains that closer.
gate_rationale.release_gate: Candidate is absent from 0.55.0 and present from 0.56.0. 2ff4a72 is absent through 0.61.0 and present in 0.62.0. 0.56.0 through 0.61.0 contain the incomplete gate without the final closure.
gate_rationale.uniqueness_gate: Absent from canonical84 counted 84. Distinct from GHSA-954P (HTTP SSRF / shared fetcher) despite the shared candidate SHA. Distinct from GHSA-RFR2 (CLI --url) and GHSA-VX7X (DNS pin).

counterevidence: Worker original_advisory_ids listed GHSA-954P. That is a sibling residual of the same candidate, not the original vulnerability. This review sets original_advisory_ids to null rather than inventing an ID.

Relative ../ local refs were ungated in the parent and were not rewritten by the candidate except a FileNotFoundError wrap. They are counted only insofar as closer 2ff4a72 extends the same AI flag. The KEEP scope is the GHSA-quoted file:// gate bypass.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: Untrusted JSON Schema $ref targets were loaded from the local filesystem with no remote-reference control and no base-path confinement.

attempted_remediation.missed: Explicitly skipped file:// inside the new gate, so --no-allow-remote-refs never applied to file://.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: A schema uses file:// (and, after the closer, the same flag also confines external local paths) to read files even when --no-allow-remote-refs is set.

final_closure.closed: Applied allow_remote_refs to file:// and confined local refs with _resolve_local_ref_path using that same flag.

scope_statement: First-party GHSA names HTTP(S) $ref SSRF. The AI allow_remote_refs=None branch still fetches. Closer 5fdba4a hardens the pre-existing shared HTTP fetcher and does not amend that AI default.

gate_rationale.identity_gate: Frozen github-reviewed GHSA-954p-556p-r752 is unwithdrawn, aliases CVE-2026-54690, names koxudaxi/datamodel-code-generator and HTTP $ref SSRF.
gate_rationale.ai_hunk_gate: Candidate authors the tri-state allow_remote_refs branch the advisory quotes, including None warn-then-fetch. Topology matches GHSA-8359.
gate_rationale.topology_gate: Same atomic Claude-coauthored squash as GHSA-8359. No human-member transfer.
gate_rationale.but_for_gate: Patch-delta fails. The omitted AI-gate case is default None still fetches. 5fdba4a leaves that branch in place and instead adds private-IP and redirect checks to http.py get_body, which already fetched with follow_redirects=True in the parent and in the candidate. Advisory range starts at 0.9.1. Maintainer text says the compatibility default was not flipped and that this report is fixed by the same shared fetcher hardening as GHSA-RFR2.
gate_rationale.fix_reversal_gate: 5fdba4a is the first-party closer and does block non-public HTTP targets on the shared fetcher. That reversal does not convert the row into incomplete-remediation causality.
gate_rationale.release_gate: Candidate is in 0.56.0 through 0.60.2 without 5fdba4a. 0.61.0 contains 5fdba4a. Containment does not save patch-delta.
gate_rationale.uniqueness_gate: Absent from canonical84. Distinct GHSA from GHSA-8359. Shared SHA does not merge cases. Sibling GHSA-RFR2 is the CLI --url entry on the same fetcher.

counterevidence: Parent and candidate http.py get_body use follow_redirects=True and have no _validate_url_for_fetch. 0.61.0 adds that validator.
0.61.0 jsonschema.py still has if not resolved_ref.startswith("file://") and still fetches after the None warning.
Advisory: The fix does not flip the --allow-remote-refs compatibility default in this patch.
A fix to a pre-existing shared fetcher after an AI warn-then-fetch default is not amending the AI-added boundary to cover the omitted fail-open case.

original_vulnerability.original_mechanism: HTTP(S) JSON Schema $ref targets were fetched with no IP or redirect confinement.

attempted_remediation.changed: Added allow_remote_refs. Default None warns and still fetches.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not flip the default to block and did not add private-network or redirect validation.

original_vulnerability.residual_bypass: Default None still fetches attacker-controlled HTTP(S) $ref targets. The later closer blocks private/loopback targets on the shared fetcher without closing that default.

final_closure.closed: Shared HTTP fetcher gained URL/IP validation and manual redirect checks. The allow_remote_refs=None fetch path remains.
